title: Aeon's End: Legacy
subtitle: Cooperative deck-building legacy campaign defending the subterranean bastion of Gravehold
tagline: Forge your breach mage. Defend Gravehold against the Nameless.
loreSummary: You are apprentice breach mages in the underground haven of Gravehold. Through grueling trials and evolving arcane abilities, you must repel the terrifying onslaught of the Nameless.
keyFeatures: Deck-building without shuffling: order your discard pile strategically
Custom character creation: evolve unique starting cards and breach powers
Tense variable turn order deck keeps every round unpredictable
Permanent market evolution and sealed legacy envelopes

aeons_end_core.name: Core Legacy Campaign (8 Chapters)
aeons_end_core.description: The definitive 8-chapter legacy narrative from apprentice trials to the cataclysmic final defense of Gravehold.

aeons_end_expedition.name: Campaign & Post-Game Expedition
aeons_end_expedition.description: The full 8-chapter legacy campaign plus a 4-battle post-game expedition mode using your fully upgraded breach mages.

aeons_end_completionist.name: Grand Defender & Challenge Gauntlet
aeons_end_completionist.description: Complete legacy campaign, multiple expedition runs, increased difficulty nemesis encounters, and full market modularity.

milestones.title: The Apprentices' Ordeal
milestones.phase: Phase I - Trial of Breach Magic
milestones.description: Novice mages undergo their inaugural trial, learning to focus volatile breaches and defend Gravehold against the first incursion.

milestones.title: The Creeping Incursion
milestones.description: The subterranean depths shudder as horrific subterranean entities probe the perimeter defenses of the bastion.

milestones.title: The Citadel Besieged
milestones.description: Malevolent forces assault the sanity of Gravehold's defenders, forcing the mages to unlock dangerous forbidden breaches.

milestones.title: The Final Reckoning
milestones.description: The fully forged breach mages stand at the epicenter of the cataclysm in a desperate final stand to preserve humanity.
